# Credits sub-actions

## Add custom credit

Adds a person to the end credits of your stream, like "Special thanks". Good for thanking someone who does not show up in follows or tips.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Section** | Which part of the credits. Use a built-in one (follows, tips, raids...) or any title you make up, like "Special thanks". Starts as: `Special thanks`. |
| **User** | The person's name. The default %user% is whoever started the action. Starts as: `%user%`. |
| **Platform** | The site the person is on, like twitch. The default %platform% is whoever started the action. Starts as: `%platform%`. |
| **Amount** | A number added to the person's total in this section, like a tip amount. 0 if it does not matter. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Detail** | Optional extra text shown next to the name, like "for the great clip". |

<small>Type id: `credits.addCustom`</small>

## Get credits

Reads the credits collected so far and saves them in variables, for example the names of all new followers. Handy for a "thanks to everyone" chat message.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Use test data** | Tick to use made-up sample credits, for trying out an overlay design. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%creditsFollows%` | The names of all new followers, separated by commas |
| `%creditsSubscriptions%` | The names of everyone who subscribed |
| `%creditsTips%` | The names of everyone who tipped |
| `%creditsRaids%` | The names of everyone who raided |
| `%creditsChatters%` | The names of everyone who chatted |
| `%creditsTotal%` | How many names there are in all |

<small>Type id: `credits.get`</small>

## Reset credits

Clears the collected credits so the next ones start fresh. Good at the start of a new stream.

<small>Type id: `credits.reset`</small>
